title: Set up your profile
lead: About 8 minutes. Your answers are saved on this device as you go.

you.lead: We use these to verify you're a real person. Employers don't see your Aadhaar number.

photo.lead: A clear, recent photo of your face. Employers see it next to your scorecard.
photo.deniedBody: Allow the camera for this site in your browser's address bar, then try again. Or upload a photo instead.
photo.missingBody: Upload a photo instead. A well-lit picture of your face works best.
photo.tooLarge: The photo is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.
photo.wrongType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.

work.lastDayHint: Your expected last day if you're serving notice.
work.lpaHint: In lakhs a year, for example 8.5.
work.industry: Industry you want to work in
work.placesPlaceholder: Type a city and press Enter
work.documentsLead: Only employers who unlock you can open them.

docHints.resignation_letter: Or your accepted resignation email, saved as a PDF.
docHints.experience_letter: From your current or last employer.
docHints.notice_period_proof: The relieving or offer letter you chose above.
docHints.present_offer: If you already hold an offer elsewhere.

resume.lead: Our AI reads your resume, suggests the roles that fit you, and fills in your background. You check everything before it's saved.
resume.label: Resume
resume.uploadFailedBody: Check your connection and choose the file again.
resume.wait: This usually takes under a minute. You can stay on this page.
resume.failedBody: Scanned images and password-protected files often fail. Try a PDF exported from Word or Google Docs.
resume.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual
resume.slowBody: Try the upload again, or come back in a few minutes; your other answers are saved.
resume.found: We found these in {{name}}. Check them and fix anything that's off.
resume.roleLead: Suggested from your resume. Your AI interview is for this role.
resume.noRoles: We couldn't suggest a role from your resume. Tell us which one you want.
resume.reasonPlaceholder: A line or two about your experience with it.
resume.clarify: That's broad. Which of these is closest?
resume.noExperience: None found. Add your jobs if you have any.

review.lead: One last look. You can change any of this later from your profile.

errors.adult: You need to be 18 or older to apply for jobs.
errors.aadhaar: That isn't a valid Aadhaar number. Check the 12 digits.
errors.pin: A PIN code has 6 digits, like 500081
errors.ctc: Enter an amount in lakhs, like 8.5.
errors.expectedLow: Expected pay can't be lower than your current pay.
errors.fileInvalid: Use a file of an accepted type, up to 5 MB
errors.reason: Tell us briefly why this role.

submitFailed: Your profile wasn't saved. Your answers are still here; try again.

preview.caption: How employers see you
preview.private: Your Aadhaar and documents stay private.

done.title: You're all set
done.lead: Your profile is saved. Our AI is already looking for jobs that fit you.

saved.title: Profile saved
saved.body: Employers find you when our AI matches you to a job.

matching.title: Matching you to jobs
matching.body: We match you to open roles as they're posted, usually within a day.

interview.title: AI interview
interview.body: Take a short interview for {{role}} so employers see your scorecard.
